age.evidence: Male Wistar rats provided by CEDEME at the Federal University of São Paulo weighing 250-300 g at the beginning of the experiments

sex.evidence: Male Wistar rats were used in this study

dosing.evidence: 2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodoamphetamine (DOI) (10.0 ug/0.3 uL); DOI was dissolved in 10% DMSO solution and 0.9% saline solution. DOI was microinjected into IC

handling.evidence: Upon arrival, the rats remained undisturbed for one week, for acclimatization in the animal vivarium.

group_housing.evidence: They were housed in groups of four in standard plastic cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: under a 12:12 dark/light cycle (lights on at 07:00 am)... The experiments were conducted during the light phase of the light/dark cycle

enrichment_housing.evidence: standard plastic cages (45 cm × 35 cm x 15 cm) with wood chip bedding

assays.assay_name: Prepulse Inhibition (PPI) of Acoustic Startle Reflex
assays.assay_description: Acoustic startle/PPI in a wire-mesh cage (16.5 × 5.1 × 7.6 cm) inside a sound-attenuated chamber. 5 min acclimation followed by 64 trials (pulse alone 120 dB, prepulse alone 75/80/85 dB, prepulse+pulse, no-stimulus); total session 22 min. Baseline session day before drug test; test session after intracerebral microinjections of DOI in IC and/or bicuculline in PPTg.

application_type.evidence: DOI was microinjected into IC and bicuculline into PTTg (intracerebral microinjection via guide cannulas)

setup_habituation.evidence: Five days after surgery... the animals were tested in a brief baseline startle/PPI session... The purpose of the preexposure was to familiarize rats to the chambers, testing procedure

setup_restrain.evidence: The equipment consisted of a wire-mesh cage (16.5 × 5.1 × 7.6 cm), which was connected to a stabilimeter; animal moved within the cage

food_restriction.evidence: food and water given were ad libitum for the extent of the study; no food in startle chamber during 22-min recording

water_restriction.evidence: food and water given were ad libitum for the extent of the study; no water in startle chamber during 22-min recording

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after that procedure [microinjection], they were submitted to the PPI test.

sample_size.evidence: Four groups of rats were used: vehicle/saline (n = 7); DOI/saline (n = 7); vehicle/bicuculline (n = 7); and DOI/bicuculline (n = 7).

outcomes.summary: Microinjection of DOI into the IC reduced %PPI at 75 dB and 85 dB prepulse intensities compared with vehicle controls. Simultaneous microinjection of bicuculline into the PPTg prevented the DOI-induced PPI deficit. Startle amplitude was unchanged across groups.
outcomes.statistics: Three-way ANOVA: IC drug F(1,36)=9.640, P=0.0037; PPTg drug F(1,36)=17.28, P=0.0002; IC×PPTg interaction F(1,36)=8.735, P=0.0055; prepulse intensity F(2,36)=10.29, P=0.0003; DOI/bicuculline vs DOI/saline at 85 dB P<0.014.
outcomes.evidence: PPI deficits was observed in the intensity of 75 dB by rats treated with DOI/saline compared to vehicle/saline and vehicle/bicuculline groups (P < 0.05)... DOI/bicuculline group showed an increase of PPI compared to DOI/saline group (P < 0.014)

B1_num_measures.evidence: The amount of PPI was calculated as a percentage score... Startle magnitude was calculated as the mean startle response to all pulse-alone trials

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Startle magnitude was calculated as the mean startle response to all pulse-alone trials during the PPI test session.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences or transitions reported

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI/startle is not an ethological behaviour

B5_social.evidence: Each rat was tested alone in the startle chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: PPI does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: signals were amplified, digitised and analysed by the software of the startle measurement system (Insight Equipment) — pressure/stabilimeter, not behavioural classifier

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate ANOVAs only; no PCA/clustering reported

E1_environment_type.evidence: commercial startle chambers... wire-mesh cage inside a ventilated, sound-attenuated chamber

E2_shelter.evidence: wire-mesh cage with no enclosed refuge

E7_social_context.evidence: The startle reaction of the rat within the wire-mesh cage — single animal

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in startle chamber during recording

D1_continuity.evidence: Five days after surgery... the animals were tested in a brief baseline startle/PPI session... The day after the baseline startle/PPI session, drug testing took place

D2_session_duration.evidence: The total duration of the session was 22 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: baseline startle/PPI session... The day after the baseline startle/PPI session, drug testing took place

D4_baseline.evidence: Each animal's average response across the trials was used to determine groups matched with equivalent mean startle magnitude and percent PPI for the pharmacological studies.

D5_followup.evidence: No recording ≥24 h after drug administration

D6_circadian.evidence: Session was 22 min, well below 6 h

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single PPI assay; merged into one entry.

D1/D3: baseline PPI session and drug test session are on separate days with data reported/used (matched groups), so scored as Multiple discrete sessions and 2-7 recording days, following glm candidate; gptoss and qwen missed this.
B1: PPI% and startle magnitude reported = 2 measures, score 1 (2-3 bin).
setup_restrain: wire-mesh cage with stabilimeter allows free movement; not body-restrained — scored 'no' (gptoss/qwen interpretation correct over glm).
Dosing: Bicuculline is a GABA-A antagonist, not a psychedelic, so excluded from dosing list per rubric (only psychedelic compound DOI listed).
Route: intracerebral microinjection into IC — not one of standard routes, scored 'other'.
DOI is psychedelic dosed intracerebrally; time_to_assay = 0 min (immediately after microinjection).
